verdict_reason: Rename-only diff (package line at 98% similarity, no test logic changed) and the tests themselves are sound, but they exercise intercept() directly and so stay green despite this PR deleting RestClientConfig.java, the sole registration site for the interceptor.

todos.issue: All 6 tests call interceptor.intercept() directly, so they still pass even though this PR deletes RestClientConfig.java (the only place TraceIdPropagationInterceptor was ever registered on a RestClient/RestTemplate); after this PR the interceptor is an unwired @Component and outbound calls no longer carry x-cdp-request-id, but the green suite hides that.
todos.fix: Re-register the interceptor on the RestClient.Builder/RestTemplate bean and add one wiring test (e.g. a @RestClientTest or MockRestServiceServer assertion, or a context test asserting the builder's interceptor list contains TraceIdPropagationInterceptor) so deleting the registration fails a test.
